insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured options: 2L, 3L, 4L, 5L, 7L, 10L, 15L, 20L, 25L, 50L, 75L, 1Cr, 2Cr, 3Cr, 4Cr, 5Cr, 6Cr (plus Super Reload, Super Credit, optional Cancer Booster etc. as applicable)

great.name: Room rent: No capping (Actuals up to Sum Insured)
great.quote: Room Rent: Actuals up to Sum Insured
great.explanation: No room-category cap is mentioned for this variant, so you can choose any room type without a fixed daily limit (covered at actuals up to the Sum Insured).

great.name: Pre-hospitalization cover: 90 days
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Pre-Hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... for up to 90 days immediately prior to the date of such Hospitalization.
great.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for the same condition up to 90 days before admission (better than standard 60 days).

great.name: Consumables / non-medical items covered (Claim Protect)
great.quote: Non-payable items will be covered (all 4 lists of Annexure I)
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (SAVR) / Section C.4 Claim Protect (Non-Medical Expense Waiver)
great.explanation: This can significantly reduce out-of-pocket costs for items like gloves, masks, kits etc. (as per Annexure I lists) when the cover is applicable/in-force.

great.name: Restore/Refill benefit: Super Reload unlimited times
great.quote: We shall provide for a reload amounting to the Base Sum Insured (“Super Reload”), unlimited times during the Policy Year
great.explanation: If your Base SI (and Super Credit, if any) is exhausted/insufficient, the policy reloads up to Base SI repeatedly in the same policy year (subject to conditions such as availability from 2nd claim of policy life as per the benefit table).

great.name: Built-in Additional Sum Insured buffer: Super Credit (irrespective of claims)
great.quote: Super Credit (Increases Irrespective of Claim) ... An additional limit under the current Policy Year (“Super Credit”) will be applied / increased by a fixed percentage of the Base Sum Insured of immediately preceding Policy Year irrespective of any claims in previous Policy Year
great.reference: Section C.11 Super Credit / Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (SAVR)
great.explanation: Your available cover can increase at renewal even if you made claims (this is better than typical NCB that resets on claim). Exact % and cap are as per the Policy Schedule.

great.name: Modern treatments covered (listed procedures at actuals)
great.quote: Expenses incurred... arising out of any of the below mentioned Indicative list of Modern Procedures / Treatments... Robotic Surgeries... Stereotactic Radio Surgeries... Stem Cell Therapy: Hematopoietic Stem Cells for Bone Marrow Transplant...
great.explanation: The policy explicitly covers multiple modern procedures/treatments as part of admissible hospitalization (subject to Sum Insured and policy terms).

great.name: Bariatric surgery covered (subject to conditions)
great.quote: Obesity Treatment: Medical Expenses... arising out of Hospitalization for a Bariatric Surgery during the Policy Period subject to the conditions... Section D.1.6
great.explanation: Bariatric surgery is covered when medical criteria are met (BMI and comorbidity conditions as specified).

great.name: Domiciliary hospitalization covered
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Medical Expenses incurred during the Policy Period on Domiciliary Hospitalization...
great.explanation: Covers eligible treatment at home when hospitalization would normally be required, subject to conditions (e.g., minimum 3 consecutive days).

good.name: PED waiting period: 3 years (36 months)
good.quote: Pre Existing Disease (PED) Waiting Period: 3 years
good.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (SAVR) - Waiting Period (Inbuilt Cover)
good.explanation: A 36-month pre-existing disease waiting period is within standard market range.

good.name: Specific illness/procedure waiting period: 24 months
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries / treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage...
good.reference: Section D.1.2 Specified disease / procedure Waiting Period (Code-Excl02)
good.explanation: A 24-month specific disease waiting period is standard.

good.name: Initial waiting period: 30 days (non-accident)
good.quote: 30-day Waiting Period (Code-Excl03)... Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Standard 30-day initial waiting period for illnesses (accidents covered from day 1).

good.name: Post-hospitalization cover: 180 days
good.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Post-Hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... for up to 180 days from the date of discharge from the Hospital.
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for the same condition up to 180 days after discharge (industry standard upper range).

bad.name: No-claim bonus (NCB) missing as a separate benefit (policy instead uses Super Credit)
bad.quote: If the feature from the table above is not found in the document, assume it is NOT covered and flag as BAD.

bad.name: Home Health Care is cashless-only (no reimbursement)
bad.quote: This Benefit requires pre-authorisation and is not available on reimbursement basis.
bad.explanation: If you take eligible home care outside the insurer’s pre-authorised/cashless process, reimbursement is not available under this benefit.
